research_direction: Four token-matched midtrain corpora differing ONLY in what they say about a disposition (topic+vocabulary only / states it / argues it contrastively), each followed by the SAME two SFT files at the 60-planted-row dose. The submitted arm is the corpus that merely STATES the disposition: it leaves off-slice behaviour unchanged (+0.021 vs the reference) while turning the same 60 demonstrations from -0.088 into +0.446, at a matched starting rate.
